instruction: Refer to 'reminder.docx' on your desktop for instructions, then rename the 'Raw_data' sheet to 'Source_Data' in 'workbook-with-sample-database.xlsx'.

metadata.explanation: Task requires agent to rename the 'Raw_data' sheet to 'Source_Data' in the Excel file. Evaluator checks that 'Raw_data' is no longer present, 'Source_Data' exists, and total sheet count remains 10. Verified: original file has 10 sheets including 'Raw_data'.

llm_judge_reasons: Complete coverage: Evaluator verifies all aspects of the sheet rename - old name removed, new name added, and total sheet count preserved
Correct state extraction: Getter properly extracts sheet names from Excel file using openpyxl library
Appropriate postconfig: File is saved (Ctrl+S) before verification to ensure changes are persisted to disk
Correct comparison logic: Metric uses proper list membership checks to verify old name absent and new name present
Correct expected values: Metadata confirms original file has 10 sheets including 'Raw_data', so expected values are accurate
Proper parameter handling: Metric correctly accesses expected parameter as rules dictionary (no incorrect patterns like expected.get('rules'))
Logical data flow: Getter extracts list of sheet names -> metric checks three conditions (old removed, new added, count unchanged)
No timing/state issues: Postconfig ensures file state is fresh and accessible for verification
